old_caption: The video showcases a close-up view of a vacuum cleaner on a speckled terrazzo floor. The vacuum cleaner is dark brown with a metallic base and features a visible cord trailing off to the left side of the frame. The cleaning head of the vacuum remains mostly stationary, with slight, repetitive movements, and steam or mist rises from the cleaning head, indicating the use of a steam cleaning function. The terrazzo floor has a light beige base with small blue and gray specks scattered throughout, giving it a textured appearance. The lighting in the scene is bright, reflecting off the glossy surface of the floor. There are no other objects or characters present in the video, focusing solely on the vacuum cleaner and its steam emission.
original_wisa_caption: The video showcases a close-up view of a vacuum cleaner in action on a speckled terrazzo floor. The vacuum cleaner is dark brown with a metallic base and features a visible cord trailing off to the left side of the frame. The cleaning head of the vacuum, which includes a brush and a suction nozzle, moves back and forth across the floor, effectively removing dirt and debris. Steam or mist rises from the cleaning head, indicating the use of a steam cleaning function. The terrazzo floor has a light beige base with small blue and gray specks scattered throughout, giving it a textured appearance. The lighting in the scene is bright, reflecting off the glossy surface of the floor and highlighting the movement of the vacuum cleaner. There are no other objects or characters present in the video, focusing solely on the cleaning process. The vacuum cleaner's movement is steady and methodical, ensuring thorough cleaning of the floor area.
caption: The video showcases a canister-style vacuum cleaner resting on a pale speckled tile floor, its glossy dark-maroon body, spoked wheel, trailing cord and coiled black hose holding steady in the frame. A rigid metal wand descends from the body to a wide floor nozzle fitted with two light-grey side wings. This nozzle head glides repeatedly toward and away from the camera along the tile surface, producing a back-and-forth cleaning motion that leaves several frames streaked with horizontal blur. As the head translates, the wand tilts slightly forward and back, and the nozzle swells closer in some moments and recedes smaller in others. A faint yellowish patch sits on the floor in the foreground, unmoved by the body's fixed position. Thin white vapor hangs around the canister and puffs near the nozzle throughout, swirling and reshaping its outline from frame to frame. The motion belongs entirely to the wand and nozzle assembly, while the canister, wheel, cord and hose remain fixed relative to the stable framing. The visible pass leaves off mid-glide, the cleaning motion still underway.
